fusions.name: Pressed Flat
fusions.desc: A heavy blow that deals 22 damage and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health, and its damage rises +6% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +30%).

fusions.name: Crushing Descent
fusions.desc: Hurls a weight at the first enemy it meets, dealing 30 damage, and it bursts for 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Weight Shift
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Evened Odds
fusions.desc: Your blunt attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour. It also reduces the cooldown of every other ability you have by 6%.
